SELECT i.irsaliye_no AS irsaliyeNo, i.irsaliye_tarihi AS irsaliyeTarihi, i.aciklama, ch.ad AS cariAd, ch.ticari_unvani AS cariUnvan 
FROM irsaliye i LEFT JOIN cari_hesap ch ON ch.id = i.cari_hesap_id WHERE i.id =  :id
SELECT m.kod AS malzemeKod, m.ad AS malzemeAd, ik.miktar, ik.adet, ik.aciklama FROM irsaliye_kalem ik LEFT JOIN malzeme m ON m.id = ik.malzeme_id WHERE ik.irsaliye_id = :id
